content:
{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the inner dimensions of the box
inner_x = 220 - 2 * 8  # Subtract wall thickness from both sides
inner_y = 300 - 2 * 8  # Subtract wall thickness from both sides
inner_z = 160 - 12     # Subtract bottom thickness

# Calculate the positions for the inner box to center it within the outer box
offset_x = (220 - inner_x) / 2
offset_y = (300 - inner_y) / 2
offset_z = 12  # Bottom thickness

# Return the calculated values
(inner_x, inner_y, inner_z, offset_x, offset_y, offset_z)"}
